title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Perfect-gas conservative equations and nondimensional force definitions exist; actual heat conduction and wall force are incomplete.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS, polygon geometry and cell adjacency implemented; root distributes owned/ghost mesh, but numerical cases did not validate geometry.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Paired face flux residual and BC paths implemented; failed/partial histories and inactive temperature gradient limit validation.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.cpp implements Rusanov and Roe/Harten–Yee with fallback; M2 metadata selects Roe.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield and mirrored wall ghost states exist, but output_writer.cpp:278–287 reports the no-slip ghost velocity itself as a boundary value rather than the zero face average; Re20 surface rows are nonzero.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: residual.cpp invokes least-squares gradients and reconstructed states; no successful production output demonstrates second-order accuracy.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth–Jespersen limiter and positivity fallback are called in residual assembly; fallback frequency in historical production unknown.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Viscous stress exists but residual.cpp:119–123 disables heat gradient and :261–275 never integrates wall shear; report falsely claims separated skin-friction force.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS pseudo-time implemented; three steady final statuses failed and no successful force plateau established.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 frozen-history two-loop code exists; time_integrator.cpp:704 assigns statistically_periodic unconditionally and no Re200 package validates inner convergence or shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS root partition, owned/ghost packing and reductions implemented; exact historical binary and controlled rank agreement remain unverified.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
